body.name: adaptive recovery tree
body.construction: A deterministic finite decision tree whose root is labelled by the free answer \(\mathcal O_{\mathbf G}(\varnothing)\), whose internal node after transcript \((I_q,\mathcal O_{\mathbf G}(I_q))_{q<j}\) chooses \(I_j\subseteq V\) with \(|I_j|\le s\), and whose leaf outputs \(\mathsf T(\mathbf G)\).
